name: István Kovács
bio:
István's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate workings of engines. He started small, tinkering with mopeds and old Ladas in his father's garage. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he joined a local rally team, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving and optimizing performance. His career progressed through various racing series, from touring cars to Formula 3, before landing his current role as Chief Engineer at Prema Junior.

István is known for his meticulous approach and his uncanny ability to diagnose complex technical issues. He demands perfection from his team and isn't afraid to push them to their limits. However, beneath his demanding exterior lies a deep respect for the dedication and hard work of his engineers. He fosters a culture of continuous improvement, constantly seeking new ways to enhance the car's performance and gain a competitive edge. His calm demeanor under pressure is a valuable asset during high-stakes races.

What sets István apart is his old-school approach combined with a willingness to embrace modern technologies. He trusts his intuition honed over decades of experience, but also embraces data analysis and simulation to inform his decisions. He believes in a holistic approach to engineering, considering every aspect of the car and how it interacts with the driver and the track.

physical.description: A man of medium height and build, István carries himself with a quiet authority.
